message.reasoning: The user wants to list all current files in temp directory including hidden files, ensuring we keep current directory structure unchanged and avoid generating any extra directories or files. So we need to run ls -a in temp directory. We should use the ls function with a=True. But we need to ensure we are in temp directory. We can call cd to temp, then ls. But the user says "在 temp 目錄內" meaning "in temp directory". So we should cd to temp. Then ls with a=True. That will list all files including hidden ones. No other changes. So we do cd folder="temp", then ls a=True.
